gate2.reason: Hard stop after Gate 1 failure; all-ten truncation was not evaluated in this R330 round.

remaining_criteria.reason: Sequential hard stop at Gate 1. No pooled performance, robustness, LOO or challenge results are being reported as if this round ran them.
